construct.en: Human OX1R · stabilizing mutations and truncations · non-fusion construct

6TP3-A.citation: Rappas et al. · J Med Chem 2020

copyNote.zh: A、B 是同一晶体中的两个 OX1R 副本，不是不同受体亚型，也不代表不同亲和力。
copyNote.en: A and B are two OX1R copies in the same crystal, not different receptor subtypes or separate affinity measurements.

sourceSection.zh: 原始论文：结合模式结果章节与图 6；坐标来自对应 PDB 条目。
sourceSection.en: Primary paper: binding-mode Results section and Figure 6; coordinates from the corresponding PDB entry.

explanation.zh: 原始论文 OX1–Daridorexant 结果章节及图 6 指认的 Asn318–酰胺羰基氢键；报告 N···O 重原子距离，不将氢原子位置视为直接实验观测。
explanation.en: Asn318–amide-carbonyl hydrogen bond assigned in the OX1–Daridorexant Results section and Figure 6. The measurement is an N···O heavy-atom distance, not a directly observed hydrogen position.

readings.zh: 6TP3 的 A/B 副本中，Asn318 ND2–NS2 O10 分别为 2.83/2.74 Å；氢键解释来自原始结构研究。
readings.en: Asn318 ND2–NS2 O10 measures 2.83/2.74 Å in copies A/B of 6TP3. The hydrogen-bond assignment follows the original structural study.

readings.zh: 芳香环境与最近原子距离
论文描述 Trp112、His344、Tyr311 等残基构成的结合环境。图中灰虚线表示实际最近原子对，未将 C···Cl 接触自动标注为卤键。
readings.en: The paper describes the binding environment involving Trp112, His344 and Tyr311. Gray lines show the actual nearest atom pairs; a C···Cl contact is not automatically assigned as a halogen bond.

readings.zh: Daridorexant 是双重食欲素受体拮抗剂，但本视图只展示已核验的 OX1R–NS2 实验结构。A/B 副本不代表 OX1R/OX2R。
readings.en: Daridorexant is a dual orexin receptor antagonist, but this view shows the verified OX1R–NS2 experimental complex. Copies A/B do not represent OX1R/OX2R.

explanation.zh: 原始论文 OX1–Daridorexant 结果章节及图 6 指认的 Asn318–酰胺羰基氢键；报告 N···O 重原子距离，不将氢原子位置视为直接实验观测。
explanation.en: Asn318–amide-carbonyl hydrogen bond assigned in the OX1–Daridorexant Results section and Figure 6. The measurement is an N···O heavy-atom distance, not a directly observed hydrogen position.
